description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming/mattermost.ex lines 12 and 37. Exclusive test path to edit: test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs. No other test, support, production, configuration, documentation, or E2E files are assigned. Existing tests in mattermost_admin_test.exs and mattermost_membership_test.exs prove Admin directly, not this delegate. Action reuse assessment: not applicable, tests only; no executable operation, Action, tool, or workflow changes. No production implementation or documentation update required.

Tests to add before any implementation (there is no production change):
1. Line 12, public Mattermost.room_members/2: call with %{url: local_stub_url, token: "test-token"} and a valid 26-character lowercase-alphanumeric room ID. Reuse Zaq.TestSupport.OpenAIStub.server/2 in the existing async ExUnit.Case, start_supervised!(child_spec); handler assert GET /api/v4/channels/<room>/members, query page=0 and per_page=200, and Bearer token; return 200 list of two different user_id maps (optionally a duplicate). Assert exact {:ok, %{complete: true, identity_platform: "mattermost", member_ids: sorted_unique_ids}} from Mattermost.room_members, proving delegate plus completed admin snapshot without partial grants. Also call Mattermost.room_members(config, "invalid") and assert {:error, :invalid_channel_id} without any HTTP request; optionally stub one HTTP 403 and assert exact downstream {:error, {403, response_body}} rather than a fabricated complete snapshot. HTTP local fake is the genuine external boundary; do not mock MattermostAdmin or inject fetch_page into production.
2. Line 37, guarded-normalize fallback: with valid metadata %{chat_type: :public, is_dm: false, external_room_id: "room-1"}, pass raw nil or non-map list and assert exact {:error, :unverified_communication_facts}; with otherwise valid raw %{ "channel_type" => "O", "post" => %{ "channel_id" => "room-1"}}, pass metadata nil or a map missing required keys and assert the same. This distinguishes fallback from the with/else failure on contradictory map payloads already tested. A bounded ExUnitProperties/StreamData property may generate non-map raw scalars/lists against valid metadata and assert they never normalize to trusted facts; retain concrete cases. Existing contradictory-room property already covers room mismatch, so do not duplicate it or generate arbitrary unrealistic input.

Fixtures/helpers: reuse aliases and existing async true IncomingNormalizationTest, OpenAIStub local server and start_supervised!; keep explicit room, metadata and response values at call sites. No new generic helper, DB fixture, Mox mock, global config mutation or shared sandbox. Unique local server per test; assert HTTP request inside stub and exact returned snapshot; no sleeps or polling. Security invariant: malformed evidence never becomes one_to_one/room or grants history. If local HTTP stub cannot provide the expected response shape, inspect OpenAIStub and MattermostAdmin.get/3 and report blocker rather than adding test-only production seams. Verify future work with isolated mix test test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs, then mix q via Context Mode; after review follow WORKFLOW_AGENT coverage handoff and final mix precommit gate, not during this planning task. E2E is unnecessary: pure Channels boundary regression, no new UX journey. No known unreachable lines: both have public entry points; line 12 needs a call on wrapper rather than Admin, and line 37 needs wrong outer argument shape rather than contradictory map. Do not run tests or alter Git for this planning issue.
title: [coverage] Cover Mattermost incoming normalization delegation and malformed inputs
